Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSL Executive Trainee (Environment) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the CSL Executive Trainee (Environment) position is 10 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Executive Trainee (Environment) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech, M.Tech, or M.Sc degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science & Technology, Environmental Engineering & Management, or Climate Science from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Executive Trainee (Environment) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Executive Trainee (Environment) post is 27 years as of the application deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the CSL Executive Trainee (Environment) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹750 for General/OBC and PwBD candidates. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Executive Trainee (Environment) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Objective Type Test, Group Discussion (GD), Writing Skills assessment, and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Executive Trainee (Environment) position?
faq.answer: During the training period, the salary is ₹50,000 per month. Upon completion of training, the salary will be in the range of ₹40,000-3%-1,40,000.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a contractual or permanent job at Cochin Shipyard?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Executive Trainee (Environment) post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Cochin Shipyard located?
faq.answer: Cochin Shipyard is located in Kochi, Kerala.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Kerala apply for this position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions for application, but it is always advisable to check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official PDF.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link will be available on the Cochin Shipyard's official website. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
